correctness.rationale: The analytic entropy difference Δ_p(z) from the cited binary convex-envelope formula is even. At z=0 its second derivative is A(p)=F(a)/a, with one interior critical root because F(0)=0, F initially positive, Fprime strictly decreasing, and F->-1 as a->1. At p*, A=0 and source second convexity condition is strict; the quartic coefficient B=[3(1-a*^2)^2-2a*^6]/a*^2>0. For δ=p*-p>0, A=-c δ+O(δ²), c=-2Fprime(a*)/a*>0. The contact minimum solves A z+(B/6)z³+O(δ z³+z⁵)=0, giving z²=6cδ/B+o(δ). Symmetry plus strict convexity outside the central nonconvex pocket makes the convex envelope constant across the two equal minima, so C=Δ(0)-Δ(z)=3 A²/(2B)+o(δ²). Independent high-precision checks for δ=1e-5,1e-6,1e-7 approach K, but asymptotics rely on Taylor and global convexity premise.
